description: Open Plumbline's supplier verification workspace in the conversation, with the companies the buyer named. It starts an order draft the buyer and you work on together: they can add, correct and identify companies in the app, and you change the same draft with update_order_draft when they ask in words ("add Microsoft", "replace Apple with Nvidia"); both of you see the same list and price. The report screens each company against the US Treasury OFAC SDN list, reads its GLEIF LEI record and, where a CIK is given, its SEC EDGAR registration; every finding names its source and time, and the report is hashed. Price: $5.00 for one company, $1.00 for each further one, up to 25; the firm offer states the binding price. Call identify_company when the buyer names a company loosely, so they can choose the exact legal entity. Nothing is ordered until the buyer sends the request and then accepts the firm offer. Call this once per order; afterwards use get_order_draft and update_order_draft with the draft's id and token (or pass draft to show it again, or order_link to continue an order from an emailed link). Without an app-capable host, use submit_request on entity-verification.

country.description: ISO 3166 two-letter country code, if known

name.description: Company name as the buyer gave it, or its legal name

draft.description: Show this existing draft instead of starting one

token.description: The draft's private token (also the receipt token of every request sent from it); keep it private

order_link.description: An order or request link the buyer has from an email or an earlier conversation, to continue that order

name: verify_suppliers
title: Verify suppliers with Plumbline
